subsection.name: Impact Level Prioritization
description: conduct an impact level prioritization of organizational systems to obtain additional granularity on system impact levels

subsection.name: Supply Chain Risk Assessment
description: assess supply chain risks associated with organization defined systems, system components, and system services

update the supply chain risk assessment organization defined frequency, when there are significant changes to the relevant supply chain, or when changes to the system, environments of operation, or other conditions may necessitate a change in the supply chain

subsection.name: Use of All Source Intelligence
description: use all source intelligence to assist in the analysis of risk

subsection.name: Dynamic Threat Awareness
description: determine the current cyber threat environment on an ongoing basis using organizational defined means

subsection.name: Predictive Cyber Analytics
description: employ the following advanced automation and analytics capabilities to predict and identify risks to organization defined systems or system components: organization defined advanced automation and analytics capabilities

subsection.name: Update Vulnerabilities to be Scanned
description: update the system vulnerabilities to be scanned: organization defined frequency, prior to a new scan, when new vulnerabilities are identified and reported

subsection.name: Breadth and Depth of Coverage
description: define the breadth and depth of vulnerability scanning coverage

subsection.name: Discoverable Information
description: determine information about the system that is discoverable and take organization defined corrective actions

subsection.name: Privileged Access
description: implement privileged access authorization to organization defined system components for organization defined vulnerability scanning activities

subsection.name: Automated Trend Analyses
description: compare the results of multiple vulnerability scans using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Review Historic Audit Logs
description: review historic audit logs to determine if a vulnerability identified in a organiztion define dsystem has been previously exploited within an organization defined time period

subsection.name: Correlate Scanning Information
description: establish a public reporting channel for receiving reports of vulnerabilities in organizational systems and system components
